query:
SELECT
            e.id,
            e.from_email,
            e.from_name
        FROM data_communication_email e
        WHERE e.timestamp >= $1
          AND e.timestamp < $2
          AND e.from_email IS NOT NULL
          AND e.from_email != ''
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM wiki_refs er
              WHERE er.source_table = 'data_communication_email'
                AND er.source_id = e.id
                AND er.role = 'sender'
          )
        ORDER BY e.timestamp ASC
        LIMIT 1000
